lead_raw_text:
The CeY₂ phase (Ce₂Y₄ per unit cell) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with six atoms distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives both Ce and Y centers a 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangement: Ce is surrounded by 12 Y neighbors, while Y has 4 Ce and 8 Y neighbors, with distances ranging from 3.25 to 3.56 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face contacts between Y-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Ce- and Y-centered polyhedra.
